generator.requiredObservation: installed path and sha256 of development/tools/make_key on the builder (a source hash is not an installed identity)

decrypt-keys.requiredObservation: referenced by generate-release.sh; replaced at signing by scripts/host-decrypt-keys.py (sha256 a022b8255a0372429c7f51b6670a46c28e707061c490bdf57b364b5bacc1432c); installed path and sha256 measured on the builder

avbtool.requiredObservation: installed path and sha256 of avbtool on the builder; it runs openssl (avb_openssl beside it, else PATH)

openssl.requiredObservation: builder host openssl used by scripts/host-decrypt-keys.py; installed path and sha256 measured on the builder

generation.note: make_key steps for the nine certificate roles (two arguments: RSA-4096). make_key reads the passphrase from stdin and always exits 1 through its EXIT trap, so success is exit status 1 plus exactly the produced files. Nothing runs until the missing items are supplied and reviewed.

avb.pem generation and encryption, and the order of avbtool extract_public_key (which needs the unencrypted key) relative to encryption
